intentionalDifferences.description: New draft envelopes and JCS addresses; reference records, hashes and approvals remain original evidence.
Initial native dispatch demo explicitly supports string-to-string functions; other signatures require later emitter profiles.
Draft waivers cover listed policy findings only; malformed, unsupported and authentication inputs cannot be waived.

An empty mapping selector is a policy-format error. Rust attributes INVALID_MAPPING_SELECTOR to the policy ID; the reference reports INVALID_VIABILITY_POLICY with a policy JSON path. Differential checks normalize only this declared formatting control; semantic finding codes and subjects stay exact.

Path hydration substitutes supplied values literally. Parameter-like text inserted as a value is never recursively reinterpreted as another template token; the pinned reference replaces it again. Independent expectations are /users/:id/literal for Rust and /users/literal/literal for the reference.

The governance draft rejects weak and noncanonical Ed25519 public points and uses strict verification. The reference Node signature primitive accepts an identity-point signature in the preserved negative control; Rust refuses that trust key before proposal authorization.

Native SSSOM ingress permits 16 MiB rather than the original reader's 64 MiB. One well-formed record at 16 MiB + 1 is accepted by the original reader and explicitly refused natively. Native topology work is bounded across all constraints at 2,000,000 checked steps and 1,024 findings per evaluator; exhaustion refuses rather than omitting obligations.

Only diagnostic names for conflicting shard records and rechecked stale generations change: SHARD_COMPOSITION_CONFLICT -> CONFLICTING_SHARD_DEFINITION; STALE_PROJECTION_GENERATION -> PROJECTION_GENERATION_RECHECK_FAILED. Original 22-case expectations and complete native findings remain intact.

The closed native scientific crate requires exact raw bytes for every declared capture source. The reference partial-source crate mode is excluded. Replay can be verified with unavailable source bytes; that does not satisfy this stricter crate completeness requirement. External producer sources remain explicit references.

acceptanceScope: Reference executions, declared native-profile destinations and original binding outcomes are separate evidence. Pure Rust, shared differentials, migrated consumers and source/native installations pass on ARM64 macOS and Linux; actual protected Linux permission/crash/lifecycle controls pass on the recorded root-owned ext4 profile. This is declared draft-profile coverage, not full old API parity, public release or production activation.
